doc.title: Branford Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Joking about drummers and the Partridge Family
summary: Banter with the interviewer about drummers, leading back to Art Blakey.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: And who else? Are there any other drummers who are of note, or…that might bear mentioning.
No, I’m not giving all that love to drummers. Enough, enough with the drummers.
Ringo Starr was a great influence.
Take everything you say with a…. (laughs)
But I think that Danny Bonaduce was probably the…. Who was the drummer in the Partridge Family, wasn’t it Danny? You supposed to know this. You’re a drummer.
You got to know your standards, man. You gotta know what’s happening. Yeah, he was something. You know, I loved that man. So, ahh…clearly, Art Blakey.
